messages:
Rae (Product): Quick sync 1: preflight UX for Private setup. Issues: vague telemetry wording, live status not announced, and dense failure help. Need small copy and accessibility fixes.
Omar (Design): Can you paste the modal copy?
Rae (Product): Current: 'We'll run a network preflight and may send anonymized diagnostics to help debug issues.'
Lee (Eng): Technically we only send probe results, IP ranges, HTTP codes, and timestamps. No tokens or payloads.
Nia (A11y): Live status needs aria-live and a visually-hidden summary. Also focus should move to results when complete and announce count.
Omar (Design): Quick copy try: 'Run preflight  we may send anonymous network data (IP ranges, probe results, error codes) to help fix connection issues. No credentials or app data are ever sent.'
Sam (Legal): Prefer 'anonymous network data' and make opt-out obvious. We also need consent logged in audit trail.
Rae (Product): Proposal: checked checkbox 'Share anonymous network data to help Redwood debug' with inline 'Turn off' link. Consent recorded.
Lee (Eng): API supports `?telemetry=false`. We'll emit audit event `preflight.telemetry_consent`. Note: probes timeout at 5s, add tooltip.
Omar (Design): Failure UI: convert paragraph into compact rows: 'What failed' / 'Why it matters' / 'How to fix' with a 'More' link. Keep each row keyboard-focusable.
Nia (A11y): Make rows focusable buttons, aria-describedby to expanded content, announce 'Preflight complete: X issues found' when done, and set focus to first row.
Rae (Product): CTA text: 'Run again' instead of 'Retry check'?
Omar (Design): 'Run again' is better. Add tiny helper: 'Tip: run as admin for permission checks.'
ui-bot: preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/previews/1799991222  build passed
Rae (Product): I'll update mocks and ping legal for final wording. Thanks all!
